_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'ASSUMPTION LOG' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-03.03.

f01_ID.label: ID
f01_ID.guidance: Unique identifier for the assumption or constraint entry.

f02_Type.label: Type
f02_Type.guidance: Specify whether this entry is an 'Assumption' or a 'Constraint'.

f03_Category.label: Category
f03_Category.guidance: The category of the assumption or constraint (e.g., Technical, Financial, Schedule, Resource).

f04_Description.label: Description
f04_Description.guidance: A clear, detailed description of the assumption or constraint.

f05_Impact_if_invalid.label: Impact if invalid
f05_Impact_if_invalid.guidance: The potential risk or impact to the project if the assumption proves false or the constraint is breached.

f06_Responsible_party.label: Responsible party
f06_Responsible_party.guidance: The person or role tasked with following up on the assumption to validate its accuracy.

f07_Due_date.label: Due date
f07_Due_date.guidance: The target date by which the assumption needs to be validated or reviewed.

f08_Actions.label: Actions
f08_Actions.guidance: Specific actions required to validate the assumption or monitor the constraint.

f09_Status.label: Status
f09_Status.guidance: The current status of the assumption (e.g., active, validated, closed).

f10_Comments.label: Comments
f10_Comments.guidance: Any additional information, operational context, or status updates.
